def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    girl_patches = image_patch.find("girl")
    toothbrush_patches = image_patch.find("toothbrush")
    
    if not girl_patches or not toothbrush_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    girl_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in girl_patches]
    toothbrush_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in toothbrush_patches]
    
    closest_distance = float('inf')
    closest_toothbrush = None
    
    for girl_center in girl_centers:
        for toothbrush_center in toothbrush_centers:
            dx = abs(girl_center[0] - toothbrush_center[0])
            dy = abs(girl_center[1] - toothbrush_center[1])
            distance = math.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
            if distance < closest_distance:
                closest_distance = distance
                closest_toothbrush = toothbrush_patches[toothbrush_centers.index(toothbrush_center)]
    
    return closest_toothbrush
